infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Aegis to access the camera to record video evidence during an active SOS emergency or photo reports.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Aegis to access the microphone for emergency voice recognition and audio evidence.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow Aegis to access your location to broadcast SOS coordinates.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow Aegis to access your location in the background to monitor your journey and broadcast SOS coordinates even when your phone screen is locked.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allow Aegis to access your contacts to select emergency contacts for SOS alerts.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Aegis to access your contacts to select emergency contacts for SOS alerts.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Aegis to access your location in the background to monitor your journey and broadcast SOS coordinates even when your phone screen is locked.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow location access to attach GPS evidence to an incident.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Aegis to access your microphone for emergency voice recognition.
